# Form settings QGIS fixture

A hand-written project whose layers hold the Attributes Form settings a catalogue carries, in the shapes QGIS saves them. It was not saved by QGIS Desktop.

Survey sites has a UUID Generator, `uuid()` defaults in each format, a fixed default, `now()` defaults, a default that reads another layer, Range, Date/Time, Checkbox and Attachment widgets (one whose storage mode picks a directory, so it is not an attachment, and two whose default root folders are absolute paths), Not null, Unique and expression constraints of each strength, read-only and hidden fields, both forms of Reuse last value, duplicate policies, Label on top, a Not searchable field, field comments, `quac_control_<field>` variables, and a Drag and Drop Designer form with nested containers, a field placed twice and each kind of data-defined Editable property. Site kinds has a form that places no field. The project saves its measurement units.
